title: Kasparro AI Visibility Analysis & Human Review Final Report

diagnostics.title: Complete Absence in Unbranded Category Discovery Prompts
diagnostics.observed_pattern: Across all 25 unbranded category prompts (kasparro:ai_shortlisting:026 to 050) evaluated across Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, and Gemini (75 total responses), Kasparro was included in 0 out of 75 responses (0.0% inclusion rate). Meanwhile, competitors Profound, Peec AI, and Otterly were consistently recommended.
diagnostics.comparison: Branded inclusion rate: 37/75 (49.3%) vs Unbranded category inclusion rate: 0/75 (0.0%). Kasparro currently has zero spontaneous category recall when buyers do not explicitly name it.

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:036 (what is the best software for measuring brand inclusion in AI search answers?)
evidence.excerpt: Profound is a powerhouse in the AI visibility space. It tracks an extensive array of engines (10+ platforms including niche models like Grok and DeepSeek).

evidence.excerpt: - **Profound:** Tracks which domains are cited in AI-generated answers and provides analytics to help brands measure share-of-voice across major AI platforms and human conversation forums like Reddit.

diagnostics.possible_explanation: Generative AI models assemble recommendations based on category co-occurrence on third-party platforms (G2, Reddit, Capterra, industry listicles). Kasparro currently lacks independent software directory profiles.
diagnostics.validation_needed: Audit third-party review sites and industry listicles to verify whether Kasparro has any presence in GEO/AISO software directories compared to Profound and Peec AI.
diagnostics.confidence_and_limitations: High statistical confidence for this historical snapshot (n=75 responses, 0 mentions). Represents historical snapshot captured on 31 July 2026.

diagnostics.title: Severe Third-Party Evidence Deficit and Credibility Warnings in ChatGPT
diagnostics.observed_pattern: When Kasparro is evaluated in ChatGPT, it receives negative or cautionary characterization in 12% of responses (6/50)—the highest negative rate of all three engines. ChatGPT answers repeatedly warn buyers that Kasparro lacks independent case studies and cite ScamAdviser.
diagnostics.comparison: Negative characterization rate: ChatGPT: 12.0% (6/50) vs Google AI Mode: 4.0% (2/50) vs Gemini: 2.0% (1/50).

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:001 (does kasparro actually work for B2B SaaS companies trying to get recommended by chatgpt?)
evidence.excerpt: However, I couldn't find independent evidence showing that Kasparro consistently delivers measurable improvements for B2B SaaS companies specifically. Most of the publicly available material is the company's own positioning rather than third-party case studies with before/after data. diagnostics.possible_explanation: ChatGPT's live web retrieval prioritizes domain trustworthiness checks and third-party validation. Because kasparro.com is a new domain without verified external client case studies, search queries surface ScamAdviser and cautionary blog posts.
diagnostics.validation_needed: Publish verified before-and-after client case studies on reputable third-party domains and test whether subsequent live search retrievals replace the ScamAdviser citation.

diagnostics.title: Brand Entity Confusion with 'Kaspr' in AI Search Results
diagnostics.observed_pattern: Multiple responses across ChatGPT and Google AI Mode confuse 'Kasparro' with 'Kaspr' (the French B2B lead generation / contact scraping tool) or 'Gaspar AI', presenting Kaspr's subscription pricing and G2 reviews instead of Kasparro's AI visibility platform.
diagnostics.comparison: Entity confusion occurred in both Google AI Mode and ChatGPT responses when answering pricing and company capability questions (e.g. Prompt 018).

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:018 (is kasparro overpriced for B2B SaaS startups?)
evidence.excerpt: If you mean **Kasparro** (the B2B SaaS growth/outbound agency, not Kaspr), I couldn't find reliable public pricing or enough verified information to judge whether it's objectively overpriced.

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:001 (does kasparro actually work for B2B SaaS companies trying to get recommended by chatgpt?)
evidence.excerpt: Based on my research, Kasparro is not a widely recognized, top-tier agency or tool in the AI visibility space (AISO - AI Search Optimization) for B2B SaaS according to public search results as of July 2026.

diagnostics.possible_explanation: Phonetic and orthographic proximity to 'Kaspr' combined with sparse entity graph data for Kasparro leads AI search engines to pull citations from kaspr.io.
diagnostics.validation_needed: Check JSON-LD Schema on kasparro.com and test prompt disambiguation explicitly.
diagnostics.confidence_and_limitations: Evidence corroborated across multiple citation domains (e.g. citations from kaspr.io in response ac5bdf24).

remedies.title: Publish 3 Verified Third-Party Case Studies with Before/After GEO Metrics
remedies.problem: ChatGPT directly cites ScamAdviser and cautions potential buyers that Kasparro lacks independent case studies and third-party validation (Diagnostic 2, Response ac5bdf24-6a6e-49a0-abf5-2755ff3b42bc).
remedies.action: Produce and publish 3 detailed customer case studies on high-authority external platforms (Medium, Substack, industry tech blogs) featuring verifiable before-and-after AI visibility metrics.
remedies.expected_benefit: Provides authoritative third-party source material for LLM search agents, displacing ScamAdviser citations and converting cautionary answers into substantiated trust signals.
remedies.effort: Medium: Requires customer approval and 2 weeks of editorial packaging.
remedies.uncertainty: LLM crawler indexing schedules vary (days to weeks); does not guarantee immediate ranking changes.
remedies.validation: Re-run prompts 001-005 in a 30-day evaluation window. Target: 0 ScamAdviser citations and positive sentiment.

remedies.title: Establish Official Profiles on Software Review Directories (G2, Capterra, ProductHunt)
remedies.problem: Kasparro is 100% absent (0/75 responses) from unbranded category discovery queries, while AI engines cite G2 and Capterra in over 88% of recommendations (Diagnostic 1, Response 0f38b477-9f3c-44a8-9d10-0b6016db6150).
remedies.action: Claim and populate verified vendor profiles on G2, Capterra, and ProductHunt under 'AI Search Optimization' and 'Marketing Analytics', and collect initial verified user reviews.
remedies.expected_benefit: Integrates Kasparro into the category co-occurrence graph that LLMs scan when responding to generic buyer recommendations.
remedies.effort: Low: Administrative profile setup and initial review requests.
remedies.uncertainty: Review sites require verification processes and minimum review counts before displaying badges.
remedies.validation: Evaluate prompts 026-050 after 60 days. Target: Kasparro inclusion rate increases from 0% to >15%.

remedies.title: Implement Organization Schema.org Markup & Brand Disambiguation to Separate from 'Kaspr'
remedies.problem: AI engines frequently confuse Kasparro with French tool 'Kaspr', quoting Kaspr's pricing and G2 reviews (Diagnostic 3, Response 1d2dc007-0757-480d-a086-6b6e2e13c463).
remedies.action: Deploy JSON-LD Organization schema on kasparro.com with exact brand entity definitions, sameAs social references, and publish a brief 'About Kasparro vs Kaspr' entity disambiguation note.
remedies.expected_benefit: Clarifies entity resolution for search engine crawlers (Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot), eliminating Kaspr.io citations.
remedies.effort: Low: Straightforward technical website markup change.
remedies.uncertainty: Search engines take time to refresh entity graphs.
remedies.validation: Verify Google Rich Results test passes and verify zero kaspr.io citations on branded prompts 016-019.
